besluite.rede: 'een vir een eindig' is natural Afrikaans and here plainly means the feathers end one after another along the edge; the proposal is a lateral move and reads stiffer.

The original reads acceptably with colour (the art element the block is about) as the subject; the proposal shifts the subject to the feathers and adds a relative clause without being clearly better for a Grade 5 reader.
'waaraan die vlerke vas is' is correct, natural Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move, and it would also reword a glossary definition, which only the writer may do.
